gloss: for a long time, forever, enduringly

definitions.gloss: for a long time to come, forever, lastingly
definitions.explanation: Expresses the wish or expectation that something will continue far into the future. Commonly used in well-wishes and formal expressions, especially at weddings and in greetings.

examples.japanese: {末永|すえなが}くお{幸|しあわ}せ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧。
⟦どうぞ→どうぞ：02920_douzo⟧{末永|すえなが}く⟦よろしく→よろしく：01070_yoroshiku⟧⟦お{願|ねが}いいたします→お願いいたします：27603_onegaiitashimasu⟧。
examples.english: I look forward to our continued relationship for a long time to come.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{伝統|でんとう}→伝統：09585_dentou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{末永|すえなが}く⟦{受|う}け{継|つ}がれて→受け継ぐ：06700_uketsugu⟧いくこと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{願|ねが}っています→願う：02387_negau⟧。
examples.english: I hope this tradition will be passed down for many years to come.

notes:
USAGE:
{末永|すえなが}く is an adverb used in well-wishes and formal expressions. It conveys the hope that a positive state will continue indefinitely into the future.

The most iconic usage is the wedding blessing {末永|すえなが}くお{幸|しあわ}せ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (May you be happy forever). It also appears in business greetings and formal letters to express a wish for a lasting relationship.

ETYMOLOGY:
From ⟦{末|すえ}→末：03362_sue⟧ (the future, what comes after) + {永|なが}い (long) in its adverbial く form — literally "long into the future."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {末永|すえなが}くお{幸|しあわ}せ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: may you be happy forever
- {末永|すえなが}く⟦よろしく→よろしく：01070_yoroshiku⟧: I look forward to a lasting relationship
- {末永|すえなが}く⟦{愛|あい}される→愛する：01811_aisuru⟧: to be loved for a long time
- {末永|すえなが}く⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧: to last for a long time
